findings.title: Reject APPLIED feedback that contradicts public authorization or work completion

spec.quote: 不能用后台记录、未来状态或自填成功回执代替。
只有实际完成、完成时授权仍有效才可能改变设施。
失败/中止/授权过期不能伪造成功或触发“恢复后”复检。

findings.behavior: _feedback validates fields, issued task identity, channel strings, operation id and timing, but does not check APPLIED against the task binding's authorization interval or the corresponding terminal workforce report. allowed.recheck then depends only on outcome == APPLIED. An internally contradictory public history can open recheck despite the contract.
findings.static_counterexample: Take the actual slice06 expired-at-completion public history at3.5s: action issued1.75, completed ACK observed3/arrived3.5, grant expires exactly3. Preserve all fields and replace intervention outcome NO_EFFECT with APPLIED and reason with null. Every current _feedback predicate remains true although the authorization excludes3. An analogous APPLIED plus aborted/rejected work report is not cross-rejected. This counterexample was reasoned from source and saved fields, not executed.
findings.related_existing_guard: src/aegis_dc/verified_closure.py:149-152 already rejects APPLIED contradicting its declared authorization interval.
findings.impact_boundary: Normal PolicySession takes feedback from the actual private InterventionSession and slice06 correctly reports NO_EFFECT. The finding is a missing consistency rejection at the public choose_work boundary, not evidence that the normal plant applied an expired action and not a demand for cryptographic authentication.
findings.requested_correction: Cross-check APPLIED against the bound grant at observation time and a consistent arrived completed workforce ACK for the same issued action; reject contradictory terminal histories and retain pending behavior if channels have different delays. Add a separately frozen finite public-input red/green correction, keeping original b8 source and all existing records.
